subject: Confirmation of Your Flight Booking
body: Dear [Recipient], We are pleased to confirm your flight booking for the upcoming trip from New York to Paris on May 15th, 2022. Your flight details are as follows: Flight number: XYZ123, Departure time: 10:00 AM, Arrival time: 3:00 PM. Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours prior to departure. Should you have any questions or require assistance, feel free to contact our customer support team. We look forward to welcoming you on board! Safe travels, The Travel Agency Team
